'''Gondolas''' were a form of transport on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dalos IV]]. Gondolas were strapped to the underside of mature [[neph]]s, massive docile flying creatures native to the planet.<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
